CargoWise One does not support automated cheque printing when one printer is used for multiple cheques. When posting payments for cheque books using the automatic print function, CargoWise One controls the allocation of cheque numbers at the point of posting to ensure that cheque numbers are always allocated AND printed in the correct sequence. In this case, CargoWise One does not allow users to enter a cheque number manually. If you do elect to use a single printer for multiple cheque books, users will be required to manually control the process of ensuring the following BEFORE posting payments:
1. That no other user should post cheque payments using this or the above cheque books 2. That the cheque paper in the printer is for the correct cheque book 3. That the cheque number of the cheque paper in the printer is the same as the 'Current No.' of the selected cheque book (press F3 on the payment's cheque book field to inspect this value)
